{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Check for -1 in customer_age
print(f"Number of -1 values in customer_age: {df[df['customer_age'] == -1]['customer_age'].count()}")
print(f"Total rows: {len(df)}")
print(f"Percentage of -1 values: {df[df['customer_age'] == -1]['customer_age'].count() / len(df) * 100:.1f}%")

# Check if any revenue contains commas
print(f"Rows with comma in revenue: {df['revenue'].str.contains(',', na=False).sum()}")

# Check the distribution of customer_segment
print(f"Customer segment distribution:\n{df['customer_segment'].value_counts()}")

# Check the distribution of converted for loyal customers
loyal_df = df[df['customer_segment'] == 'loyal']
print(f"Loyal customers: {len(loyal_df)}")
print(f"Loyal customers who converted: {loyal_df['converted'].sum()}")
print(f"Loyal customers who did not convert: {loyal_df['converted'].count() - loyal_df['converted'].sum()}")"}
